contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [----]TRAIANO [?OPTIMO?]AVG GERM DAC ; R/ PARTHICO[--]V [?VMIOO?] COS VII SPQR

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), probably issue of 116-117. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, curled features left and right may represent draped or mantled shoulders. Obverse inscription: [----]TRAIANO [?OPTIMO?]AVG GERM DAC. Reverse description: Fortuna seated left with rudder. Reverse inscription: PARTHICO[--]V [?VMIOO?] COS VII SPQR. In exergue: FORTRED. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 2.86gms, die axis; 6
